label: An originating cause has an occurring existentially productive exercise
term: productive-exercise reading of an originating cause
definition: OriginHasProductiveExercise F Occurs bearer produces: for every CausesOrigin c x edge, there exists an exercise a with Occurs a, bearer a = c and produces a x. CausesOrigin retains its existing primitive CAUSE_4 meaning of causal responsibility for x coming to be. The new bridge relates that cause to the already defined existential-production framework: an occurring exercise of the very source causes the existence of its target. It is not a definition of every sort of cause, self-cause prohibition, necessary-being explanation or maintenance. Examples under the proposed reading include an existing builder exercising a productive capacity in bringing about a house; a process maintaining a house that already exists does not thereby originate it. Whether a given process truly produces bare existence rather than a transformed state remains open.
note: Analyst bridge, attribution deferred. The untimed CausesOrigin field has no defined temporal or ontic priority law, so a new interpretation premise is required; its applicability to actual origination is OPEN. The source's ordinary-language 'other than itself' phrase in DEF-CAUSE-OF-ORIGIN is not used to prove the conclusion by definition. A simultaneous or non-well-founded originating mechanism that fails bearer-to-act or act-to-product explanatory priority is a possible typed rival, but consistency alone does not demonstrate an actual productive process. Linked comparison: docs/notes/unique-feedback-explanation-311.md; existing existential-priority definitions specify the separately open structural conditions. The bridge does not say an exercise is produced by its own target.
